title: Attachment downloads
blurb: Message attachments start collapsed. Choose Attachments or focus it and press Enter or Space to show or hide the list. The header keeps the file count and Save as ZIP visible. Each file keeps Preview when supported, Save and Open. PDF previews show the message sender. Choose Save PDF as… to close the preview and save that attachment to a location you choose. To use the saved copy in an open draft, return to Compose and choose Attach files. To compare two PDFs, choose View → Separate window, open both messages and their PDFs, then choose Place readers side by side. Use two visible, unmaximized readers on the same display. Closing a preview returns to its message. PDF previews expose extracted plain text to assistive technology in PDF extraction order; scanned pages have no OCR. Long files load progressively; closing Preview stops remaining preview work. Failed page rendering shows Retry; resizing or revisiting the page also retries. Canvas dimensions and displayed page height are limited to 4096 pixels, scaling down unusually tall pages. Text selection, in-preview links and a print toolbar are unavailable; Save or Open the file for those operations. Repeated filenames have separate actions. The choice stays on that reading surface during a message refresh and resets for another message; it is not a saved preference. Collapse does not cancel transfers; use Attachment transfers to cancel. Preview, Open and Save share downloads. Complete files up to 32 MiB can be reused for five minutes while Morrow is open; larger files remain on demand. Save asks for a location first. ZIP preparation runs one at a time and can be cancelled before saving. If preparation is busy, retry after another ZIP finishes. Once saving begins, cancellation cannot undo a file already written. Attachment transfers show progress and individual Cancel controls; closing Preview keeps another Save or Open running. Downloads allow 64 MiB per file and 128 MiB per ZIP, with existing provider limits. Changed identities stop reuse; reopen legacy Gmail selections. Forward prepares every original attachment before opening compose, within the 25 MiB outgoing limit. Included files appear in compose and its send preview; remove any file before sending if needed. Failed, cancelled or changed-source preparation opens no partial forward; retry from the original message. Resuming a server draft prepares every attachment before editing, within the 25 MiB outgoing limit. Preparation shares the download cache and Cancel controls. Failure keeps the saved draft for retry. Inline file identities are retained. Bot access remains metadata only. In the message reader, choose Add to save list on files you want, then move between messages in that window. Open Save list to check the sender, subject and date, and remove anything you do not want. Choose one folder, review the final filenames and confirm Save selected files. Existing files are kept, even if a name is taken after review. Results show which files saved and why others could not. Cancelling skips remaining files and keeps completed saves. Dismissing the list or completing a save clears it. The limit is 64 MiB per file and 128 MiB for the list.
